flow.title: One rental, start to finish
flow.lead: Each step starts with the data from the one before. The customer entered at booking flows into the contract, the contract into the handover form, the return into the invoice. Nobody types the same thing twice.
flow.step1_body: Comes from the panel, your site or connected channels. Rate plans, campaigns and extras work out the price.
flow.step2_body: The contract fills from your template and becomes a PDF. The customer approves remotely with a signed link and an SMS code.
flow.step3_body: Field staff fill in the handover form on a phone: mileage, fuel, damage points, photos.
flow.step4_body: The same form opens for the return. Differences, toll passes and extra charges are written to the rental.
flow.step5_body: The deposit is released, the payment is posted to the account, the invoice is issued from the rental.
fleet.title: The fleet's week on one screen
fleet.body: The fleet calendar shows every vehicle's bookings, blocks, transfers and maintenance on one timeline. Rules decide which vehicle is open at which branch, on which dates, for which channel.
fleet.p1: Vehicle catalogue, segments and rental groups
fleet.p2: Transfers between branches and one-way rules

handover.p3: Field task board and a My tasks screen
handover.p4: KABİS notification records from handover and return
finance.title: A money trail from deposit to vehicle profit
finance.body: Deposits, payments, customer accounts, cash and bank movements live in the same record as the rental. Reports show which vehicle, branch and channel actually make money.
finance.p2: Invoices, supplier invoices and supplier payments
finance.p4: Occupancy, income/expense, channel and ageing reports

site.title: Bookings on your own domain, under your own brand
site.body: Each company sets up its own booking site from the panel: pick a template, set colours and fonts, work on a draft and publish when it is ready. The site reads prices and availability from the panel and writes bookings back to it.
site.i1_body: Four templates, your colours and fonts. Preview the draft, publish when it is ready.
site.i2_body: The site opens on a subdomain of your own first. You connect your domain with a DNS check.
site.i3_body: Add the booking form to your current site with one snippet. It only runs on domains you allow.
site.i4_body: Customers open their booking with an SMS code, see their documents and pay.
site.i5_body: Enquiries from the site land in the panel. You write and publish guide articles from the panel.
site.mock_caption: Your company's booking site and the widget snippet
site.mock_heading: Pick a car, collect it at the branch.
control.title: Each branch sees its own work, you see all of it
control.body: Branches, roles and permissions are set up the way your company works. Staff only see the screens and actions they are allowed to. Sensitive actions ask them to confirm who they are again.
control.i1_body: Each branch's vehicles, handovers and till are tracked separately; the branch comparison report puts them side by side.
control.i2_body: You define your company's roles. Permissions work per screen and per action.
control.i3_body: Sign in with a passkey or an authenticator app. Actions like a deposit release ask for verification again.
control.i4_body: Every company's data is kept in its own space; one company's users cannot see another company's records.
control.mock_caption: Sample roles and permissions: three roles, four actions
connect.title: Talks to the services you already use
connect.body: Connections are set up per company, with encrypted account details. Every send goes through a job queue; failures are retried and show up in the panel.
connect.sms: SMS and one-time codes with Netgsm
connect.note: KABİS, HGS/OGS and e-invoice records are prepared in the panel. The official provider connection is switched on once a provider is chosen; toll passes can also be imported from a file.
faq.title: Common questions
faq.a1: Car rental companies, from a single office to fleets with many branches. Setup follows your own branches, vehicles and roles.
faq.q2: Do I need a separate service for the booking site?
faq.a2: No. The site is part of the panel; prices, availability and bookings come from the same data. Connect your own domain or add the widget to your current site.
faq.q3: Can field staff use it on a phone?
faq.a3: Yes. The handover and return forms and the My tasks screen are made for phones. Photos attach straight to the rental and wait on the device when the connection drops.
faq.q4: Which sales channels does it connect to?
faq.a4: The channel manager works with Yolcu360 and Obilet. Commission, capacity rules and a channel performance report are tracked per channel. Agencies with their own software can connect through the Public API.
faq.q5: How do KABİS, HGS and e-invoices work?
faq.a5: Records are prepared in the panel from handover, return and rental data. The official provider connection is switched on together with you once a provider is chosen. Toll passes can be imported from a file and matched to rentals.
faq.q6: Which languages does the panel support?
faq.a6: The panel is Turkish first with complete English. Each user picks their own language, and you set the booking site's default language.
faq.a7: We prepare a quote based on your branches and fleet. Mention them briefly in your demo request.
closing.title: Let's walk through it with your own fleet.
closing.body: Tell us how many branches and vehicles you run in your demo request. We'll talk through the right setup together.
